props.name: shape
props.description: What the placeholder mirrors. text: a stack of lines, the last one shorter. circle: an avatar. rect: a media box with an aspect ratio. block: a free box sized by the consumer through --sj-skeleton-width and --sj-skeleton-height. group: the container of a layout, it carries aria-busy, owns the delay and minimum-duration timing and swaps the skeleton slot for the loaded content. An unknown value falls back to block.

props.name: lines
props.description: Text only: how many lines, clamped to 1..12. The last line is shorter whenever there is more than one.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Rect only: width to height ratio, reserved before any media loads so the swap causes no layout shift. An unknown value falls back to 16/9.

props.name: size
props.description: Circle only: avatar diameter from the control size tokens. An unknown value falls back to md.

props.name: loading
props.description: Group only: true while the content is loading. The skeleton is laid out (and reserves its space) at once but stays invisible until delay has passed, so a fast load never flashes; once visible it stays at least minDuration.

props.name: delay
props.description: Group only: milliseconds to wait before the skeleton becomes visible. Defaults to the --motion-skeleton-delay token (300ms). 0 shows it at once.

props.name: minDuration
props.description: Group only: milliseconds the skeleton stays visible once shown, even if the content arrives sooner. Defaults to the --motion-skeleton-min-duration token (500ms).

props.name: announce
props.description: Group only: the single polite announcement ('Loading activity'), handed to the live-region registry after mount, once, when the skeleton becomes visible. A load that finishes before the delay announces nothing. Omit it when the skeleton sits inside SJState, which announces its own heading.

props.name: animation
props.description: A subtle shimmer sweep. It is static under prefers-reduced-motion and under forced colors whatever this value is.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Group only: the loaded content, rendered once loading is over and the minimum duration has elapsed.

slots.name: skeleton
slots.description: Group only: the placeholder shapes that mirror the final layout, rendered while loading. Compose SJSkeleton shapes (text, circle, rect, block).
